WITH RECURSIVE assumable AS ( SELECT r.oid AS roleid, r.rolname::text AS rolname, 0 AS depth, ARRAY[r.oid] AS path FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname = CURRENT_USER UNION ALL SELECT parent.oid, parent.rolname::text, a.depth + 1, a.path || parent.oid FROM assumable a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m ON m.member = a.roleid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles parent ON parent.oid = m.roleid WHERE a.depth < 16 AND (m.set_option OR m.admin_option) AND NOT (parent.oid = ANY (a.path)) ) SELECT roleid::int8, rolname, max(depth)::int8 FROM assumable GROUP BY roleid, rolname ORDER BY rolname

WITH RECURSIVE assumable AS ( SELECT r.oid AS roleid, 0 AS depth, ARRAY[r.oid] AS path FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname = CURRENT_USER UNION ALL SELECT parent.oid, a.depth + 1, a.path || parent.oid FROM assumable a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m ON m.member = a.roleid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles parent ON parent.oid = m.roleid WHERE a.depth < 16 AND (m.set_option OR m.admin_option) AND NOT (parent.oid = ANY (a.path)) ) SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assumable a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m ON m.member = a.roleid WHERE a.depth >= 16 AND (m.set_option OR m.admin_option) )

SELECT r.rolname::text, n.nspname::text, c.relname::text, c.oid::int8, (r.oid = c.relowner), pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.rolname, c.oid, 'INSERT'), pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.rolname, c.oid, 'UPDATE'), pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.rolname, c.oid, 'DELETE'), pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.rolname, c.oid, 'TRUNCATE'), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('r', c.relowner))) AS priv WHERE priv.privilege_type = 'INSERT' AND (priv.grantee = r.oid OR priv.grantee = 0)), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('r', c.relowner))) AS priv WHERE priv.privilege_type = 'UPDATE' AND (priv.grantee = r.oid OR priv.grantee = 0)), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('r', c.relowner))) AS priv WHERE priv.privilege_type = 'DELETE' AND (priv.grantee = r.oid OR priv.grantee = 0)), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('r', c.relowner))) AS priv WHERE priv.privilege_type = 'TRUNCATE' AND (priv.grantee = r.oid OR priv.grantee = 0)) FROM unnest($1::text[]) AS wanted(rolname) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles r ON r.rolname = wanted.rolname JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON true JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname <> 'pg_catalog' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema' AND n.nspname <> 'pg_toast' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_temp_%' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast_temp_%' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'f') AND ((r.oid = c.relowner) OR pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.rolname, c.oid, 'INSERT') IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE OR pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.rolname, c.oid, 'UPDATE') IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE OR pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.rolname, c.oid, 'DELETE') IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE OR pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.rolname, c.oid, 'TRUNCATE') IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE)

SELECT r.rolname::text, n.nspname::text, c.relname::text, bool_or(pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.rolname, att.attrelid, att.attnum, 'INSERT') IS NULL OR pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.rolname, att.attrelid, att.attnum, 'UPDATE') IS NULL), bool_or(pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.rolname, att.attrelid, att.attnum, 'INSERT') IS TRUE OR pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.rolname, att.attrelid, att.attnum, 'UPDATE') IS TRUE), bool_or(pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.rolname, c.oid, 'INSERT') IS TRUE), bool_or(pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.rolname, c.oid, 'UPDATE') IS TRUE) FROM unnest($1::text[]) AS wanted(rolname) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles r ON r.rolname = wanted.rolname JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON true JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute att ON att.attrelid = c.oid AND att.attnum > 0 AND NOT att.attisdropped WHERE n.nspname <> 'pg_catalog' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema' AND n.nspname <> 'pg_toast' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_temp_%' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast_temp_%' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'f') GROUP BY r.rolname, n.nspname, c.relname HAVING bool_or(pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.rolname, att.attrelid, att.attnum, 'INSERT') IS NULL OR pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.rolname, att.attrelid, att.attnum, 'UPDATE') IS NULL) OR bool_or(pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.rolname, att.attrelid, att.attnum, 'INSERT') IS TRUE OR pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.rolname, att.attrelid, att.attnum, 'UPDATE') IS TRUE)

SELECT w.ord::int8, w.schema_name, w.table_name, n.oid::int8, c.oid::int8, c.relkind::text, c.relowner::int8, pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)::text, c.relrowsecurity, c.relforcerowsecurity, c.relreplident::text, pg_catalog.obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class'), pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(CURRENT_USER, n.oid, 'USAGE'), pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(CURRENT_USER, n.oid, 'CREATE'), pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(CURRENT_USER, c.oid, 'SELECT'), pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(CURRENT_USER, c.oid, 'INSERT'), pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(CURRENT_USER, c.oid, 'UPDATE'), pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(CURRENT_USER, c.oid, 'DELETE'), pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(CURRENT_USER, c.oid, 'TRUNCATE') FROM unnest($1::text[], $2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS w(schema_name, table_name, ord) LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.nspname = w.schema_name LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.relnamespace = n.oid AND c.relname = w.table_name AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') ORDER BY w.ord

SELECT c.oid::int8, a.attnum::int4, a.attname::text, a.atttypid::int8, a.atttypmod, a.attnotnull, a.attcollation::int8, coll.collname::text, a.attidentity::text, a.attgenerated::text, pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(ad.adbin, ad.adrelid), pg_catalog.col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum), t.typname::text, tn.nspname::text, t.typtype::text, t.typbasetype::int8, pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(CURRENT_USER, a.attrelid, a.attnum, 'SELECT'), pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(CURRENT_USER, a.attrelid, a.attnum, 'INSERT'), pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(CURRENT_USER, a.attrelid, a.attnum, 'UPDATE') FROM unnest($1::int8[]) AS ids(oid) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = ids.oid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON t.oid = a.atttypid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace tn ON tn.oid = t.typnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_collation coll ON coll.oid = a.attcollation AND a.attcollation <> 0 LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef ad ON ad.adrelid = a.attrelid AND ad.adnum = a.attnum ORDER BY c.oid, a.attnum

SELECT c.oid::int8, ic.relname::text, i.indisunique, i.indnullsnotdistinct, a.attnum::int4, a.attname::text, u.ord::int8 FROM unnest($1::int8[]) AS ids(oid) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = ids.oid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index i ON i.indrelid = c.oid AND i.indisprimary JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(attnum, ord) ON true LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = u.attnum ORDER BY c.oid, u.ord

SELECT c.oid::int8, ic.relname::text, i.indnullsnotdistinct, a.attnum::int4, a.attname::text, u.ord::int8 FROM unnest($1::int8[]) AS ids(oid) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = ids.oid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index i ON i.indrelid = c.oid AND i.indisunique AND NOT i.indisprimary JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(attnum, ord) ON true LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = u.attnum ORDER BY c.oid, ic.relname, u.ord

SELECT src.oid::int8, con.conname::text, fn.nspname::text, fc.relname::text, sa.attnum::int4, sa.attname::text, da.attnum::int4, da.attname::text, u.ord::int8 FROM unnest($1::int8[]) AS ids(oid) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class src ON src.oid = ids.oid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_constraint con ON con.conrelid = src.oid AND con.contype = 'f' JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class fc ON fc.oid = con.confrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid = fc.relnamespace JOIN LATERAL unnest(con.conkey, con.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(src_att, dst_att, ord) ON true JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute sa ON sa.attrelid = src.oid AND sa.attnum = u.src_att JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute da ON da.attrelid = fc.oid AND da.attnum = u.dst_att ORDER BY src.oid, con.conname, u.ord

SELECT c.oid::int8, pol.polname::text, pol.polcmd::text, pol.polpermissive, pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(pol.polqual, pol.polrelid), pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(pol.polwithcheck, pol.polrelid) FROM unnest($1::int8[]) AS ids(oid) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = ids.oid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_policy pol ON pol.polrelid = c.oid ORDER BY c.oid, pol.polname
